$schema_comment: receipt_billers.json — maps biller-name patterns in email payment receipts to Notion row Names. Used by the email-bills-classify-and-remind cron when it detects an inbound payment-receipt email. Each entry: a list of regex patterns to match in the receipt body, the exact Notion Name to look up, the cron_extract recipe (how to extract the amount + dedup key), and notes. Add a new entry when a new gateway/biller shows up. The cron's `nu-html-body` recipe reads this file; the PSE / Aval / ePayco / Telefónica recipes (added 2026-07-02) also do.

$how_to_add.1: When a new receipt email shows up in the digest as 'unknown receipt biller', inspect the .eml, find the biller-name string, and add an entry below.
$how_to_add.2: For each entry: `body_match` is a list of regex strings (case-insensitive) that, if any match the receipt body's plaintext, identifies this biller. `notion_name` is the exact Name in the Notion Bills DB. `extract` is the recipe name (nu-html-body, pse-plain-text, epayco-html, telefonica-plain-text, aval-plain-text).
$how_to_add.3: The cron should skip the entry if its `extract` recipe is not implemented yet — it will fall through to the LLM-decides path. Adding a recipe requires editing bill_receipt.py.

receipt_billers.notes: Tigo postpaid family plan. Two phone lines (3002252797, 3002253221) per receipt; each receipt covers one line. A full month = 2 receipts. Nu is the only payer in practice; bills arrive directly from Tigo via a separate path (out of scope here).
Claro Hogar internet/TV at the Cali house. Reference is the account number 53517534 in Nu's receipt body.

Cali utility bill (electricity + water + aseo + tasa + alumbrado). Account holder: Diana Maria Vargas Castellanos, contract 47041524. The receipt's `Número de pago electrónico` (9 digits) is the same Electronic Payment Code the bills cron extracts from the EMCALI email — they should match when both flows run.
Cali natural-gas bill. May be paid by Nu (most common) or by another rail. Amount varies month-to-month.

HOA fee for the Cali apartment building (KRABI tower). ALWAYS paid via PSE / Aval Pasarela / AvalPay Center — 3 confirmation emails land per payment (one per rail). The receipt's `Descripción` matches the bill description exactly. The Admin row is in the bills DB; this entry maps the receipt to it.

Movistar prepago topups paid via ePayco/Daviplata. Small amounts (~$20k COP). These are NOT the regular Tigo postpaid bill — they're add-on topups that show up as ePayco receipts from `telefonica.com.co` or `epayco.com`. The cron's job is to attach the receipt to the Tigo row (no extra bill line) but NOT overwrite the Tigo row's Price (which is the recurring postpaid amount). If a Movistar topup should be its own row, edit this entry to point at a new 'Tigo Topup' Notion name.

Direct payment confirmation from `telefonica.com.co` for Movistar line 6109151707. Same destination as ePayco Movistar receipts — also a Tigo 📱 topup. skip_price_update: true for the same reason as movistar-topup.
